scope: Site copy verified against public v1.36.0: the Bangs page (/bangs), its Features board tile and homepage card. Written before the release as candidates in docs/website-candidate-claims-bangs.json (owner decision, October 17, 2026) and moved here once v1.36.0 shipped; the bang data, the try-it module and the labels are pinned to the v1.36.0 tag.

bangsCore.qualification: A bang is `!` plus a site's code at the start or the end of the text, resolved inside Blanc for every search engine; a known code shows a hint row and Enter opens the bang's address; a bare code opens the site's home; `!` alone lists recent and popular bangs and more letters filter by code or site name; an unknown code searches as typed. Desktop only.

bangsTryIt.qualification: The page's try-it box runs a byte copy of bangs.js and the catalog at this commit, so its hint rows and addresses match the app's; it shows no recents, no custom bangs and no open tabs, and it never navigates or sends what is typed.

bangsPrivacy.qualification: Blanc resolves the bang itself and opens the bang's own address, never the selected search engine first; 40 bangs at this commit send the words through Google or DuckDuckGo to search one site (site:, inurl:, sites=, cx=, sitesearch= or domains= limits, or a DuckDuckGo !bang redirect) and the directory marks them. No suggestion request is made while a bang-shaped token is in the box (text typed before a trailing bang may already have been sent). Recently used codes stay on the device, are never recorded from private tabs, and are cleared with history.

bangsCustom.qualification: Settings, General, Your bangs takes a code, a name and a search address with %s (https, or http only to this computer or the home network); the list syncs only when Profile Sync is on, and the device that saves last wins.

bangsList.qualification: The list is Kagi's open bang list (MIT) at a pinned commit, bundled in the app and changed only by a Blanc update; Blanc makes no request for it. 10,624 bangs at this commit. Not an endorsement by Kagi.
